info.title: LightX2V API
info.description: LightX2V OpenAPI for AI image and video generation. Create an API key at the platform user menu. API channel credits cost 2x web UI pricing. Human-readable docs: https://x2v.light-ai.top/api-docs

HTTPBearer.description: API Key created at the LightX2V platform. Format: `apikey_...`

ErrorResponse.description: Structured API error. The exact detail depends on the endpoint.

details.description: Machine-readable error context. Parameter validation errors may include field, expected, actual, allowed, minimum, maximum, or related fields.

S2VMultiTalkObject.description: One driven person in a multi-role S2V package. The audio and mask filenames must refer to files in the same top-level directory map.

audio.description: Top-level filename of this person's timeline-preserving audio track.

mask.description: Top-level filename of this person's black-and-white mask image.

S2VMultiConfig.description: Decoded UTF-8 contents of config.json. One talk object is valid and drives only the selected person in a group image; multiple objects drive multiple people.

S2VMultiDirectoryData.description: S2V multi-role package as a top-level filename-to-raw-Base64 map. It must contain config.json, one original_audio.* final mixed soundtrack, and every audio/mask file referenced by config.json. Values do not include data URL prefixes. Masks must match the input image dimensions (selected person white, everything else black). Role tracks must keep the original timeline and total duration, with other speakers silenced rather than removed or concatenated.

MediaInput.description: Image, video, or audio input. Use base64 for local files, url for public links, or directory for an S2V multi-role package.

data.description: Media content matching type: a string for base64/url or an S2V directory map.

MediaInputOrList.description: One media input, or a list of media inputs for tasks that accept several references in the same slot (i2i / i2av multi-image, ref2av references).

ImageInputMeta.description: Source image dimensions used for quote calculation.

VideoInputMeta.description: Source video dimensions and duration used for quote calculation.

InputMeta.description: Media dimensions and duration for billing/quote (no file upload).

audio_seconds.description: Driving audio duration in seconds, including S2V multi-role audio.

caption_config.description: Burned-in captions for digital-human output. When captions are requested, include {"enabled":true} in the original s2v submission. For a trusted voice asset URI, the server binds its trusted subtitle track automatically; do not generate an uncaptioned video first or substitute an exported subtitle file.

enabled.description: Set to true when the user requests burned-in captions.

language_hint.description: Optional ASR language hint used only when a subtitle track must be created, such as zh-CN or en.
